scope: New standard 11x11 campaigns; existing saves unchanged; no live publication performed.

verification.methods: Actual GameEngine ticks in controlled synthetic factories, using Dev Sources where useful and finite ordinary reserves for consumption checks. Server-rendered UI contracts and renderer geometry/cache identity checks; no browser session or normal-play balance run.
covered: Seeded exact counts, bands, fixed family mix, early clear cardinal neighbor, tier-8 Unknown Device, quadrant balance, footprint validity and repeatability over 1000 seeds
All 29 eligible Doubler recipes with unchanged ingredient debit and twice every resolved product/waste quantity; saved staged release for oversized batches through five-item buffers
Chance outcomes match ordinary single rolls, double only the resolved result, and survive save/load without rerolling
Rapid 10x and Reclaimer 4x fixed base rates; ordinary Tri Extractor/Doubler research; unchanged ordinary Recycler Water requirement
Tri Extractor one-reserve-to-three-items cycles, per-port stock/routing, correct outlet refunds, full-branch blocking and resource switches
All seven Core tiers, fixed five-second duplication, mixed Core FIFO, shared five/five buffers, separate active Core, two-space reservation, pause/save/load/relocation
Non-deletion, copying/template restrictions, post-victory existing relocation research, one-of-each-Core bill and valid same-map moves
Old-save/larger-world opt-out, custom spawn compatibility and preserved existing terrain/encounter fixture rules
Pink Unknown Device, purple other landmarks, hidden recipe controls/effect, port geometry and seed-aware hint retirement
verification.pageReadback: All five changed Page blocks matched; complete Page body equals the repository proposal.
verification.compatibilityNote: New campaigns carry landmarkEligible; switching larger then back to standard before leaving Home restores the layout. Older saves never gain eligibility.

limits: No normal-play pacing or long campaign balance validation
No actual Pixi/browser font-fit or color-contrast review; geometry and static markup were tested
Larger maps do not receive this first landmark layout; selection of a larger map disables its unopened layout
Custom world-spawn mods may require adjusted valid placement, or leave a Tri Extractor disconnected if no eligible reserve survives
